title: VIDEO: Is Jensen Huang likely to return as Nvidia CEO?
text:
Since the scandal about the CEO of Nvidia's relationship with an alleged Chinese spy, the US chip company has inspired shock and horror amongst onlookers. Silicon Valley is pushing for Jensen Huang to return after his resignation, but the US Congress is gearing up for multiple investigations into the way Nvidia does its business. It comes as the US President heads to a summit this week with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin. Liza Tobin is the former China Director at the National Security Council who worked across the Trump and Biden administrations and advised AI and chip policy.Watch the full interview on Australian Broadcasting Corporation.
